title: Synthetic Nature
summary: Material, light, and machine imagination shaped into a quiet visual study.
history: Synthetic Nature is a visual research series exploring how generated form can feel tactile rather than artificial.
The process moved between prompt direction, material tests, and composition studies to build a restrained image language.
The outcome is an evolving archive of sculptural images for editorial and motion applications.

title: A Sence Identity
summary: A refined identity system for a fictional sensorial beauty platform.
history: A Sence was imagined as a beauty platform where product, scent, and space share one composed visual language.
The identity favors calm surfaces, subtle contrast, and tactile materials over decorative gestures.

title: Kinetic Signal
summary: A sound-reactive title study built from orbiting light and controlled velocity.
history: Kinetic Signal began with a simple question: how can sound leave a visible trace without becoming literal?
Light trails, metallic cores, and orbiting paths were tuned into a modular motion language.

title: Nocturne Disc
summary: An ambient electronic sketch shaped by resonance, space, and slow repetition.
history: Nocturne Disc is a compact ambient study built around small changes in texture and repetition.
The archive is prepared for NAS-hosted MP3 previews and external full-track links.
